units.source_text: 朔风异常凛冽，令人难于禁受。

en.t: The north wind was unusually bitter, almost impossible to endure.

units.source_text: 枝上红叶尽行脱落，狼藉满地，而全无人足践踏的痕迹。

en.t: All the red leaves had fallen from the branches and lay scattered across the ground, with no trace at all of anyone having stepped on them.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言看了这景象，徘徊不忍遽去。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru looked at the scene and lingered there, unable to bring himself to leave at once.

units.source_text: 有些寄生的常春藤附缠在姿态优美的深山古木上，还毫不褪色地活着。

en.t: Some parasitic ivy clung to the graceful old trees deep in the mountains, still living without the least fading of its color.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言命人从其中摘取一些红叶，拟带回去送给二女公子。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru ordered someone to pick a few red leaves from among them, intending to take them back as a gift for the Second Princess.
